NFL DFS Projections Week 8: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 30, 11:17 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate: 27.7 DraftKings points at $9,500. He also holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations, more than any other player on the slate, with Chase Brown second at 28% for $6,300.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are Bijan Robinson (23.9, $8,500), Josh Allen (22.8, $7,700), Kenneth Walker III (22.8, $8,800) and Puka Nacua (21.8, $8,600). Josh Allen returns the most per dollar of that group at 2.97 projected points per $1,000. Puka Nacua leads the wide receivers at 21.8 for $8,600, Josh Allen leads the quarterbacks at 22.8 for $7,700, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 18.7 for $7,400.

The 11-game slate runs from a 54.5-point total in BAL at BUF down to 39.5 in CLE at PIT. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 30, 11:17 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 8 DraftKings projections

Josh Allen, BUF vs BAL ($7,700)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 22.8 DraftKings points at $7,700, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 1.2 points clear of Dak Prescott. The model includes 6.7 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.97 projected points per $1,000, 12th of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 22.9 points with a simulated floor of 9.0 and a ceiling of 41.7, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 3-point favorite at home against Baltimore, with an implied team total of 28.75 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Dak Prescott, DAL vs ARI ($6,300)

Dak Prescott projects 2nd at the position with 21.6 DraftKings points at $6,300. The salary works out to 3.43 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Prescott averaged 21.8 points with a simulated floor of 7.8 and a ceiling of 39.7, and he holds 18% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 7-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 30.75 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Value: Justin Herbert, LAC at LAR ($5,000)

Justin Herbert projects for 17.2 DraftKings points at $5,000, which works out to 3.44 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 20 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 4.2 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Herbert averaged 17.3 points with a simulated floor of 6.9 and a ceiling of 31.3, and he holds 3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Chargers are a 6.5-point underdog on the road against the Rams, with an implied team total of 19.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.
